title: When the Wreck Falls
author: Sable Ishikawa
blurb: Oscar Oyelaran, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
